keep_playing_why: In B something new happened about every minute (float the raft, thread the stone arches, trap the crab) and I always knew what to do and got a proper ending, so each gap felt like progress. In A I lost eight rematches in a row to Barnacle and could not tell what I was doing wrong; the quick rounds and big crashes felt great against the first rival but the difficulty spike would make me delete it. A has better pick-up-and-play rhythm and I enjoyed Endless Squall, so this is close.
better_made_why: B looks like a finished storybook, the camera work and water are lovely, and the tide dial ties every puzzle together; the bugs I saw were minor (dark transition frames, fast drags ignored, empty world after the ending). A is also polished, with great crash effects, music and rival intros, but it has a text overlap on the results card ('Lady MarrowSCORE'), 4 to 5 s of empty sea after every round, and a steering bar that is small and hard to read.
furthest_A: Beat Pip (Tilt 5, 2,250 pts) and Lady Marrow in Endless Squall (2,150 pts, streak 1, won Long Lance); lost to Contessa Brisa in Endless; lost 8 straight rematches to Bosun Barnacle (best round 3 to 4 of 5 pips, never won)
furthest_B: Finished the main story: Nell, well shard, Tam's boat, Shellflats wreck lens, Needles with 5 knocks, beat the Undertow crab (3 of 3), lit the Stack lighthouse at about 300 s; end card '5 min on the coast, 67 m of sea moved, 5 knocks, 0 of 5 lost things found'. Second run: started Pip's toy boat and Marta's pots quests, got the boat to the beach, found 0 of 5 lost things.
